title_en: A step toward defining the Standard Model on a lattice
title_zh: 迈向在格点上定义标准模型的一步
summary_en: This article explores a candidate nonperturbative lattice definition of the Standard Model, addressing the challenge of formulating the theory beyond perturbation theory. It details how GPT-6 Astra assisted in transforming the conceptual idea into a detailed proof, highlighting the role of AI in advancing theoretical physics. The work represents a step toward rigorously defining the Standard Model on a lattice, which could enable first-principles nonperturbative calculations.
summary_zh: 本文探讨了标准模型的一种候选非微扰格点定义，旨在解决超越微扰论表述该理论的难题。文章详细介绍了GPT-6 Astra如何协助将概念性想法转化为详细证明，凸显了AI在推动理论物理进展中的作用。该工作代表了在格点上严格定义标准模型的一步，有望实现第一性原理的非微扰计算。
content_en: Explore a candidate nonperturbative lattice definition of the Standard Model and how GPT-6 Astra helped turn the idea into a detailed proof.
content_zh: 探索标准模型的一个候选非微扰格点定义，以及 GPT-6 Astra 如何帮助将该想法转化为详细证明。
